item.title: SHYREG: rainfall and discharge quantiles anywhere in the territory
item.description:
SHYREG refers both to a method for estimating rainfall and floods with long return periods and to the two databases derived from it: SHYREG Rainfall, which provides rainfall quantiles on a regular grid, and SHYREG Discharge, which provides discharge quantiles at catchment outlets, including ungauged ones.

The databases give, for example, the 100-year 1-hour rainfall on any square kilometre of mainland France, or the 10-year peak discharge of a small stream with no gauging station. Such values are used in particular for hydraulic structure design, flood hazard mapping and risk studies.
